summary: Read issue354,related/dossier/previous unreceived-esse attempt and InfinityEternity.lean; materialized/read complete pinned AQUINAS-ST-I-Q7-A1 and A2 with q3a4 context. New actual-route design finding: a1 distinguishes matter perfected/determined by form from received form contracted in amplitude by matter; a2 permits an immaterial subsistent created form to be unlimited relative to matter while its ESSE remains received in determinate nature. Receipt and limitation must therefore retain act/respect indexing. In the a2 created-form context, stated essence/esse nonidentity motivates reception, not the converse needed to infer nonreception from ROOT-ESSENCE-IDENTITY. The q3 Profile has no reception relation; bare equality of its Principle-valued maps supplies none. Proposed limitation-only-by-receiving-potency decomposition still needs identity-to-unreceived applicability, independently defended exhaustion of relevant formal esse restrictions, and faithful connection to existing primitive Infinite. A new name for no receiver-limitation would not prove the old equality-to-Infinite target. Detailed precise witnesses, source directions, positive semantic distinctions and design obligations persisted in docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md (plurality note owned by concurrent adversary). No new claim/definition/relation/Lean/model or premise change.
blocker: Independently justify why the same candidate represented as essence=esse cannot have a genuine receiving principle, establish that all relevant limitations of its esse arise from appropriate receiving potency, and connect typed unrestricted formal perfection to the existing primitive Infinite semantics without hiding the target in a universal bridge.
